nice_level.description: Nice value for process scheduling (-20 to 19).

threads.description: Number of processor threads (0 to auto-detect).

maxram.description: Max available RAM in hundreds of MB (0 to auto-detect).

window.description: Max compression window in hundreds of MB (0 for heuristic).

backend.description: Compression backend: lzma, bzip2, gzip, lzo, zpaq, none.

check.description: Check integrity of file written to disk on decompression.

delete_source.description: Delete source file after successful operation.

keep_broken.description: Keep broken or damaged output files.

unlimited_window.description: Use unlimited window size beyond ramsize.

tmpdir.description: Temporary directory path (empty to use TMP env var).
